text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: While strolling through the streets of Landosol, {0} spotted a familiar figure among the passing crowd.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ランドソルの街を散歩中の{0}は、
道行く人々の中に、見知った姿を見かけた。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……うぅ～ん。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I just can't seem to get into my usual groove today~
Maybe it's because I haven't slept much?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりいつもの調子が出ないね～
あんまり眠れてないからかな～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？　
あっ……！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Haitai~♪
text_block_list.orig_text: ハイタ～イ♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Aha~, that was quite the lively greeting~
But you know, boys are supposed to say "Haisai" instead~sa
You'd do well to remember that~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～、
元気な挨拶だったね～
でもこの挨拶、
男の子は「ハイサイ」って言うさ～ね～
覚えておくといいさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
So, what brings you here today~sa?
I'm on a patrolling job for Caon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで、
今日はどうしたさ～？
私はね～
【自警団（カォン）】のパトロール中だよ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Is something troubling you~? Go ahead and tell me~
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんか困ったことでもあった～？
私に言ってみるといいよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's not something related to my Caon's duties...
You and I are just that close, {0}~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
【自警団（カォン）】としてじゃなくても、
{0}と私の仲だからね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Ahhh... How embarassing, so you saw that~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～……
恥ずかしいところ、
見られちゃったね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I'm supposed to be the cheerful one, so it's super embarrassing to let someone see me feeling down~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は元気が取り柄だから、
沈んだとこ見られるのは
でーじ恥ずかしいさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
But don't worry too much about it~!
It's nothing serious, and I'll be back to my usual self in no time~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
気にしなくていいよ～！
そんな大したことじゃないし、
すぐ元通りになるさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
You're curious why I'm like this?
Because we're close, you and me...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
気になる？
私と{0}の仲、だから……？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, looks like you turned my own words back on me~♪
Are you really that curious~?
It's honestly not such a big deal~
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
私の台詞、
逆に言われちゃったね～♪
そんなに教えてほしいの～？
本当に大したことじゃないんだよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Mm... I had a nostalgic dream~sa...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
懐かしい夢を、
見たんさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: A dream... of my hometown...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の……
故郷の夢をね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if you remember, {0}? Like I mentioned before...
I couldn't go back home and was sleeping rough all alone...
After a series of events, Caon took me in and looked after me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}は覚えてるかなー？　
前にも言ったけど～
私、
故郷に帰れなくて
一人で野宿とかしてたところを、
いろいろあって
【自警団（カォン）】に保護してもらったんだよー

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I was planning to live here in the city until I found a way to return home~ But in the end, I still haven't found one~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
故郷に帰る方法が見つかるまで、
この街で暮らすつもりだったんだけど～
結局まだ、
方法は見つからないままさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
But things are fine, you know~?
I'm never short on food or clothing, I have a shelter...
I found a job, and I made some really important friends, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
平気だったんだよ～？
衣食住には不足してないし、
仕事も見つかったし、
大事な仲間もできたしね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: And yet lately, I've started dreaming about my hometown again~ It made me feel terribly lonely all of a sudden~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なのに最近、
ふと故郷の夢を見ちゃってさ～
無性に寂しくなっちゃったってわけさー

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I guess it's a classic case of homesickness.
Doesn't really suit me to be like this, does it?
I wish you'd just laugh at me and make it go away~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
完全にホームシックってやつかな。
らしくないよね～、
笑い飛ばしてほしいさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Mm~... Ahaha~♪ It tickles~sa...
But it feels so good~♪
I can feel your kindness through the palm of your hand~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～、
あはは～……♪
くすぐったいさ～……
でも、
気持ちいいね～♪
{0}の優しさが
手のひらから伝わってくるよ～……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~♪ What's with the funny face all of a sudden~sa?
Were you trying to cheer me up?
You're so kind, {0}~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは～♪　
急に変な顔してどうしたさ～？
もしかして、
楽しい気分にさせようとしてくれたの～？
{0}は優しいね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Thanks for worrying about me~sa
But there's really nothing that can be done about this, so you don't have to worry about it so much~
text_block_list.orig_text:
心配してくれてありがとさ～
でも、
こればっかりは
どうしようもないからね、
そんなに気にしなくても大丈夫よ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: More~...? Are you really so interested in my hometown~sa?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もっと～？
私の故郷のこと、
そんなに興味があるさ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Then leave it to me~sa! I want you to learn more about my hometown, and come to love it as much as I do~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
なら任せるさ～！
{0}にもっと故郷のこと知ってもらって、
大好きになってもらいたいからね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Let's see~... In my hometown, you can see the sea no matter where you are, and it's always sparkling in the sunlight~
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね～
私の故郷は
どこからでも海が見えてね、
いつもキラキラ輝いてるんだよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Tee-da... The sun is incredibly bright, and the clear blue sea catches its rays and sparkles~
There are all sorts of plants you don't see around here, too~sa...
It's a place filled with the most vivid colors~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
てぃーだ……
お日さまがでーじ眩しくて、
その日差しを、
青く澄んだ海が受け止めて
輝いてるわけさー
こっちじゃ見ない植物も多くて、
すごく色鮮やかなところなんだよー

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
There's all kinds of unusual foods to find~
We catch plenty of fish, and the vegetables grown beneath the blessings of Tee-da are something else!
Goya (Bitter melon), soki, pineapples... There's so much delicious food~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
食べ物も珍しいのがいろいろあるんだよ～
魚はいっぱい取れるし、
てぃーだの恵みで育った野菜は格別！
ゴーヤーにソーキにパイナップル、
おいしいものたくさんさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
The towns are always so lively...
If you listen closely, you can hear the sound of the sanshin, and sometimes you'll see people dancing to the rhythm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
街はいつも賑やかでね～
耳を澄ますと三線の音が聞こえてきて、
そのリズムに合わせて踊ってる人たちがいたりして……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
And besides, on top of that...! A-Aha~
Nothing beats seeing and feeling it for yourself, after all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにそれに
……
あは～
やっぱり、
実際に見て、
感じるのが一番だね～……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I can't stay like this~sa...
At this rate, I'm going to end up worrying everyone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメさ～
こんな調子じゃ
みんなを心配させちゃうよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I'm not going to think about my hometown anymore!
I'll clear it right out of my head and just do what I can right now~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん。
もう、
故郷のことは考えないようにする！
すっきり頭の中から忘れて、
今できることをやるさー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: You bet~sa! Dwelling on things forever just isn't like me, after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろんさー！
いつまでも悩んでるなんて、
私らしくないからねー

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
With that settled, it's time to get back to patrolling~sa!
If I slack off, the whole of Caon is going to get mad at me, so I'd better get going!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうと決まれば、
パトロール再開さー！
サボってたら
【自警団（カォン）】のみんなに怒られちゃいそうだから、
そろそろ行くねー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: See you around!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
またね～！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: ──The next day.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──翌日。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time to head out on patrol with plenty of energy today!
If I keep moving, any homesickness will vanish in no time~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ～
今日も張り切ってパトロールに出発だよ～！
体を動かしてれば、
ホームシックなんて
すぐ消えてなくなるさー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Mm...! The Tee-da's so bright today.
Reminds me of the sunlight back home...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はてぃーだも明るくて、
いい天気だねー
故郷の日差しを思い……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, no, no! I can't!
I'm zoning out again! Gotta focus... focus on work!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って
ダメダメ～！
またぼんやりしちゃうさー！
仕事に集中、
集中よ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
That said, things have been peaceful around town lately.
It's a wonderful thing for the whole world to be at peace, of course, but...
It does make me start thinking about all sorts of unnecessary things...
text_block_list.orig_text:
とはいえ、
最近街は平和だからね～
世界中が平和なのは
すごくいいことだけど、
いろいろ
余計なこと考えそうになっちゃうねー……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Huh? Isn't it kinda bright~sa?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……んっ？
あれ？　
なんか眩しいさー？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
It's like sunlight reflecting off something and shining straight into my eyes...?
Almost like being by the seaside back home... No, wait!
Where is this light coming from...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お日さまの光が、
何かに反射して
直接目に入ってくるみたいな～？
まるで故郷の海辺に、
じゃなくて～
この光は、
どこから～……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aaah! {0}, what are you doing?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～っ！
{0}、
何やってるのー！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Is that a mirror you're hiding behind your back~sa?
So you were up to some mischief, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今後ろに隠したの、
鏡さ～！？
{0}がイタズラしてたんだね～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
You were using a mirror to reflect the Teeda's light, weren't you?
Oh, come on!
You really shouldn't do things like that, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
鏡で、
てぃーだの光を反射させてたでしょー！
も～！　
そういうことしちゃダメだよ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I'm on patrol so I'm going to go now~
But if you keep causing trouble, I'll have to catch you and give you a good talking-to, you hear~?
And then Makoto's gonna give you a knuckle sandwich~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私はパトロール中だから
もう行くね～
あんまりイタズラしてたら、
捕まえてお説教だよ～？
マコトにゲンコツされちゃうからね～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what that was all about?
Maybe he's just at that age where he wants to play pranks?
I feel like I went through a phase like that back in the day, too~sa...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだったのかなー？
イタズラしたいお年頃ってやつかなー？
昔、
私にもあった気がするさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Back home, I used to climb palm trees and such...
Eh?! Oh man, I feel like I'm about to start reminiscing again~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
故郷にいたころ、
ヤシの木に登ったりして～
って、
また思い出しそうになってるさ～！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Stop thinking about anything unnecessary!
That's it! I'll get something to eat and fill up my belly~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
余計なことは考えない！
そうだっ、
ご飯でも食べて
お腹を膨らませるさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Thanks~sa! *Munch, munch*...
It's still missing that bitterness, though!
The real thing is much more bitter, and it's delicious when you stir-fry it, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～？　
ありがとさ～！
モグモグ、
やっぱり苦みが足りないね～！
本物はもっと苦くて、
炒めるとおいしいんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Wait, {0}!
You're still here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って{0}！
まだいたの～！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: You went out of your way to bring me something that looks like goya... What are you up to~?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わざわざゴーヤーっぽいものを持って、
何やってるの～！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
A treat?
I appreciate it, but I'm not really in the mood to look at anything that looks like goya right now~sa.
It just makes me think of home, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
差し入れ？
ありがたいけど、
今はゴーヤーっぽいものは見たい気分じゃないさー
故郷のこと、
考えちゃうからね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Well then, see you around for real this time~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
今度こそ
またね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Phew... even with a full stomach, I don't really feel any different.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ～、
お腹いっぱいになっても、
あんまり
変わらないね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I don't see anyone in trouble at all...
I mean, it's great that it's so peaceful, but still~sa...
text_block_list.orig_text:
困ってる人も全然見かけないしー
平和なのはいいことだけどさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: ...? What is this sound I'm hearing~sa?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……？
なんか、
聞こえるさ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Is it... an instrument? Is someone playing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは、
楽器の音……？
誰かが演奏してるっぽい？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
They're not that good...
But I can feel the passion behind it~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんまり上手じゃないけど、
気合みたいなものは伝わってくるさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Back home, my body would naturally start moving whenever I heard music...
text_block_list.orig_text:
故郷だったら、
音楽が聞こえてくると
自然に体が動き出してたところだけど……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Wait, you again, {0}?!

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the rhythm is a bit too unique to dance to...
Why are you performing in a place like this?!
Everyone around you is totally startled~sa...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅん、
踊るには
ちょっとリズムが独特過ぎるよ～？
どうしてこんなところで演奏してるの～！？
周りの人たちも
ビックリしてるさ～！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: ...Or rather, {0}. You've been following me around the whole time, haven't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……というか{0}。
私のこと
ずっと追いかけてきてるでしょ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: On top of that... The Tee-da's light, that goya-like thing, this music...
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかも、
てぃーだの光とか、
ゴーヤーっぽいものとか、
この演奏とか。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: You're trying to recreate the stories I told you about my hometown, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私から聞いた故郷の話を、
再現しようとしてるよね～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Why are you trying so hard to make me remember my hometown when I'm trying so hard to forget about it~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうして必死で故郷のこと忘れようとしてるのに、
思い出させようとするわけ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: ...I see... You have amnesia, so you don't remember anything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
そっかー……
{0}は記憶喪失で、
なんにも覚えてないんだよね。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: You better than anyone understand the pain and sadness of forgetting about what you care for~
text_block_list.orig_text:
忘れることの辛さとか、
悲しさとか、
{0}の方が、
すっごく分かるんだね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Feeling lonely when I think of my hometown...
It's all because it's so precious to me, because I love it so much...
text_block_list.orig_text:
故郷のこと思い出して
寂しくなったりするのは、
大切だから……
大好きだったから。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
However trying to forget it all just because I feel lonely...
That's the wrong way to go at it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
寂しいからって、
無理やり忘れようとするのは……
間違ってるんだね。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
So that's why you went to such great lengths...
To make sure I wouldn't forget my hometown~
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから{0}は、
私が故郷のことを忘れないように、
一生懸命いろいろしてくれてたんだね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks, {0}~sa. Your kindness warms my heart
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ありがとさー
{0}の思いやり、
胸の奥があったかくなるさー

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It's a strange kind of warmth, one I never even felt back home. I feel like that lonely feeling is slowly melting away~sa...
text_block_list.orig_text:
故郷でも感じたことない、
不思議なあったかさだよ～
寂しい気持ちが、
やんわり消えていく気がするさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm really getting into the groove now~sa!
I can feel the energy surging through my body...
I just want to dance~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
調子が出てきたさー！
なんか、
体がウズウズするね～！
踊りたくなってきたさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
{0}, I'm totally game~sa!
Let's dance together♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}、
手を出すさ～！
一緒に踊ろ～っ♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Even if I were to feel lonely again, as long as I hold hands with you like this and dance I'm sure I'll be fine... No, to put it in the words of my hometown...
text_block_list.orig_text:
また寂しくなっても、
こうして
{0}と手を繋いで踊れば、
きっと平気……
ううん、
故郷の言葉で言うと──

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Nothing to Worry About~♪
text_block_list.orig_text: なんくるないさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Kaori continues to sing and dance alongside {0}. Riding the lively rhythm, she lets her thoughts drift to her beloved hometown.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}と一緒に歌い、踊り続けるカオリ。
賑やかなリズムに乗せて、大好きな故郷に思いを馳せるのであった。
